'''The Wayfarers' Rest''' is an inn located in the town of [[Whitebridge]] in [[Andor]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wayfarer's Rest, The}} It is on the main square where the [[White Bridge]] meets the east bank of the [[Arinelle]]. It is a reasonably large establishment with the common room divided in half by a low wall, designed so that feuding ship crews can be separated into areas where they are unlikely to run into one another. The inn is owned and run by Master [[Bartim]].

[[Rand al'Thor]], [[Mat Cauthon]] and [[Thom Merrilin]] visited the Wayfarers' Rest on their way to [[Caemlyn]], and learned from Bartim about the defeat of the [[false Dragon]] [[Logain Ablar]]. Bartim also told them that [[Padan Fain|a crazed man]] had passed through the town searching for them a week earlier. Rand and his cohorts had an altercation with [[Floran Gelb]] whilst leaving the inn and were attacked by a [[Myrddraal]] in the square outside, resulting in a battle that saw several buildings damaged by fire. [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] later passed through the town and had a meal at the Wayfarers' Rest before continuing their pursuit of Rand and Mat.
